conceptBlocks.text: 高销售指净销售金额高，不代表销量件数高。毛利率为商品总毛利除以总净额，不是各订单毛利率的简单平均。NTILE(4) 将排序后的商品尽量均分成四组，第一组为销售靠前的一组；

syntax.purpose: 统计截止日 2025-12-31；金额 整数马币分；比率按题设；输出粒度 商品。

problem: 商品经理查找2025年有效线下商品中，净销售额位于第一四分组且毛利率严格低于30%的商品，按净额降序输出。

methodBlocks.text: a 在商品粒度累计净销售、退货冲减后成本、折扣及退款；b 用全体商品净额降序排名分箱，商品编号为并列决胜键。外层再筛第一组和未舍入毛利率低于30%的商品；零净额作为空值不能判断。
退款折扣是诊断线索，净额已经扣除，不再扣第二次。

breakdown.title: 按商品汇总净额、成本、折扣及退款
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id)
SELECT * FROM a ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按商品汇总净额、成本、折扣及退款（a）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

breakdown.title: 按销售额划分商品档位
breakdown.sql:
WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a)
SELECT * FROM b ORDER BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 LIMIT 3;
breakdown.purpose: 按销售额划分商品档位（b）的实际执行结果。
breakdown.reason: 在示例数据上运行该步骤，核对中间结果后再进入下一步。

completeCode.mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0),2) margin_pct,discount discount_cents,refund refund_cents FROM b WHERE bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30 ORDER BY net DESC
completeCode.sqliteSql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0),2) margin_pct,discount discount_cents,refund refund_cents FROM b WHERE bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30 ORDER BY net DESC

resultBlocks.text: 八件商品分四档，每档两件。商品1净额10000、成本8000、毛利率20%，入选；商品2虽属第一档，毛利率44.44%，不入选；商品3毛利率5%，但在第二档。
原企业预览商品169净额1160554分、毛利率17.73%，应核对定价、采购及促销，不能仅凭低毛利认定亏损。

comparison.text: 销售排名与毛利率是两个独立维度；四分组不保证同额商品同档。

example.text: 先筛毛利率低于30%的商品，再对剩余商品分四档。

correction.text: 先以全体目标商品分档，再应用低毛利筛选；使用未舍入比率判定阈值。
